[[File:Ravinda.jpg|thumb|right|The village of Ravinda.]]

'''Ravinda''' is a village in [[Kandor]], located on the main road from [[Canluum]] to [[Chachin]], west of [[Manala]]. It is two days' ride from Chachin. It is fairly small, consisting of several buildings clustered on a main street with a wide field outside used as a meeting point and bartering ground for traders from several surrounding villages. In {{ne|979}} the village had at least one inn, ''[[The White Tower (inn)|The White Tower]]'', named in honor of the [[Aes Sedai]] stronghold.

[[Moiraine Damodred]], [[al'Lan Mandragoran]], [[Ryne Venamar]], and [[Bukama Marenellin]] passed through the village on their way to Chachin in 979.
